text:
Tara: FYI kicking off a short sync for the SI field enablement wave. Need to align HW manifests, marketplace listing readiness, and trainer cert slots. Target milestones: partner review by Oct 4, kits packed Oct 12, trainer cert Oct 14-16.

Ben: Quick logistic question  are we sending universal power adapters in the kit or region-specific? Last time APAC needed IEC C5 adapters.

Hiro: Recommend region-specific adapters to avoid returns. We'll include adapter SKU table and mark them on the manifest. Also flag any ECCN for export paperwork.

Tara: Good. Manifest fields: SKU, Qty, ECCN (if export), ESD-required (yes/no), packing-type. I'll paste the sample manifest after this.

Maya: Marketing wants partner permission for co-branded collateral. Need logos and one-line quotes by Oct 1 to hit marketplace announcement Oct 18. Legal: any special embargo rules?

legal: Partners that requested pre-announce review must get drafts 7 days prior. Also flag any logo usage constraints in the partner addendum. Send all materials to legal@redwood with subject "SI: Collateral Review".

Ben: Ops note: carrier preference - DHL APAC, UPS EU/NA. For bulky kits we need pallet lead time of 4 business days. Will the kit include a return label?

Tara: Yes include return label + RMA instructions. Also include a provisional badge QR card so mentors can register while they wait for final verification.

Hiro: Certification flow question: will we require an on-demand screencast of bringup or a live proctored session? Screencast is easier across timezones.

Maya: Proposal: screencast + a short MC quiz for auto-grade, and a 10% manual spot-check by graders. Pass threshold 75%. We can offer live proctor slots for those who prefer.

Ben: Please add "Fragile - electronics" and "Return to Redwood" to the outer box. Also, include the invoice/PO stub inside the package for customs checks.

Tara: Sample manifest snippet:```
SKU,Qty,Description,ECCN,ESD,Packing
RDW-SIKIT-V3,1,SI mentor compute tray,5D002,yes,foam
RDW-ADPTR-EU,1,EU power adapter,,no,box
RDW-USB-IMG,1,USB image w/ checksums,,no,antistatic
RDW-RMA-LBL,1,Prepaid return label,,no,flat
```

Hiro: For marketplace listing: use feature flag `si_onboard_field_v3` for early partner access. Marketing to confirm copy.

Maya: I'll send the flag to the marketplace team. Also we'll need a short integration checklist for SI partners that covers: marketplace enable, feature-flag toggle, contact provisioning, and sample billing test.

Ben: Logistics timeline: need final addresses by Oct 5 to guarantee Oct 12 pack date. Also need cost center + PO before we hand to procurement. PO code proposal: RDW-SI-2026-44.

Sam-ops-bot: [automation] pack-prep job scheduled (job_id=pack-3325)  expected pick-up: 2026-10-10.

Tara: Action items:
- Ben: confirm adapters by region + carrier plan (due Oct 3).
- Hiro: publish manifest templates + integration checklist (due Oct 1).
- Maya: send feature flag + partner collateral deadline to marketplace & marketing (due Sep 30).
- Legal: review collateral submissions (on receipt).

legal: Noted. We'll prioritize any partner with embargo clauses.

Maya: One more ask  can we include a short troubleshooting card with `lab-provision` commands to reduce first-call support? Example snippet below.

Ben: Yes please. That reduced tickets last time.

Tara: `lab-provision` snippet for the troubleshooting card:
```bash
# quick start (mentor)
redwoodctl lab provision --image si-field-2026 --role mentor --ssh-key ~/.ssh/id_rsa
redwoodctl lab status --wait --json | jq '.nodes[0].ip'
ssh mentor@<ip> -- sudo rdw-setup --verify
```

Hiro: I'll add that to the one-pager and include a checksum for the USB image.

Ben: I'll assemble the shipping manifest ticket in Logistics and request procurement approval with the PO.

Tara: Thanks all  please post exceptions here (power, export, logo restrictions) so we can track them. Closing this thread later today unless blockers are raised. :white_check_mark:
